class: Controls that are not the applicant's questions counted as open questions
symptom: Embry-Riddle (Workday), 28 September: the job posting page went to the AI three times, which answered only 'click Apply' -- three requests of a 20-a-day allowance.
site: Workday (Embry-Riddle); any posting with a search box or a language picker
root_cause: The shortcut that skips the AI applied only when no question was open and no dropdown showed 'Select'. A posting's job search box or language picker is neither the owner's question nor part of the application, but it counted as one.
why_tests_missed: The profile-first tests used pages with only application fields; none had a posting's own boxes beside its Apply button.
fix: PageAgent.posting_plan(): when the way on is a plain Apply and nothing still open is required, the page is opened without the AI.
prevention: Decide what a page is for before deciding what on it needs answering, and keep the cheapest path for pages whose only purpose is to be moved past.
